approach: Native C/C++ source port using SDL2, OpenGL ES 3.0 and a PsyCross-based PlayStation SDK layer.
notes: First public Android build of the native PS1 source port. Includes configurable touch controls, physical gamepad support, disc import, mod management, unused-content gallery, and optional English and Brazilian Portuguese subtitle downloads. Requires Android 6.0+, arm64-v8a and OpenGL ES 3.0. Landscape only; launcher UI is English. Game data is not distributed.
